Split one count-data row into time intervals

Source: R/split_time.R
split_time_row.Rd

Split one count-data row into time intervals

Usage 

split_time_row(
  source_row,
  start,
  duration,
  outcome,
  event_times,
  period,
  interval_info,
  is_date
)

Arguments

source_row

A one-row data frame from the original count data.

start

Name of the row start variable.

duration

Name of the row duration variable.

outcome

Name of the aggregate count variable.

event_times

Optional names of the event-time offset columns.

period

Optional name of the original period variable.

interval_info

A normalized interval specification returned by count_interval_info().

is_date

Logical indicating whether the row start variable inherits from Date.

Value

A data frame containing one row per interval intersected by source_row, with split timing, duration, period, and outcome columns.
